caveats: Franklin Reliable Movers LLC (B01381) was listed in a Sept 2024 NJ Division of Consumer Affairs action against unlicensed movers (nj1015.com lists 'Franklin Reliable Movers, Somerset' among movers fined $5,000) and its FMCSA record shows USDOT 3617452 active but not authorized for interstate for-hire operations. Verify current NJ licensing before any engagement or referral.

Two entries are miscategorised in batch.json: B01385 'G.F. Auto Repair & Transmission Service' now operates as the used-car dealer GF Used Auto Sales LLC at the same address (repair work still advertised), and B01386 'Majestic Auto Inc.' is a used-car dealership, not a repair shop.

Address discrepancies seen: Cross Town Auto Body's own site/schema says 310 Handy St while directory listings (and batch.json) say 263 Baldwin St; Mirola lists a Somerset address though batch.json places it in New Brunswick; Franklin Reliable Movers is registered in Somerset with a New Brunswick storefront; J&J spells its street 'Sanford' while directories use 'Sandford'.
Ratings in this batch come from third-party aggregators (Birdeye, Loc8NearMe, magicpin, d7leadfinder, howardskeyandlock, allbiz) rather than Google Maps directly; treat them as indicative only.

G.F. Auto Repair and GF Used Auto Sales being the same business is an inference from an identical street address (174 Remsen Ave) plus review text mentioning both repairs and purchases; no state filing was checked.

Cross Town Auto Body's blank hero was reproduced twice at 1440px and at 390px in a fresh Chrome profile; I could not determine whether it is a script/lazy-load failure in that environment or broken for all visitors, so treat it as 'observed broken, cause unconfirmed'.
data_gaps: Google Business Profile ratings, review counts and claim status were not read directly (no Maps access path used); every rating cited comes from a directory or aggregator.

The NJ Division of Consumer Affairs press release page (njconsumeraffairs.gov/News/Pages/09252024.aspx) returned an empty body in the browser, so its text was not read directly; the enforcement detail is sourced from the nj1015.com article instead.
Ralph's Auto Repair (B01383) has no verifiable website or GBP ownership status; whether a profile is claimed is unknown.
No pricing, revenue or employee-count data was found for any business in this batch; all size judgements are inferences from public signals.
Website screenshots were taken through a headless-controlled Chrome with an empty profile; ad blockers/consent walls were not exercised, so cookie-banner behaviour on first visit was not assessed.
